notes: New in 1.4.13: choose where finished downloads go - Settings > Save location now copies them into any folder you pick. The Live TV tab has Live TV, Movies and Series sections (you can mark a source as live or video yourself) and a search box. The player gets rotation, aspect-ratio and audio-track buttons and handles headphones and interruptions properly. Agent replies show as formatted text with tappable links. Plus many fixes for background downloads, notifications, RSS feeds and the update check.
